description: r3:F4 / r5:F5 — an 11e disembark move (18.04) is a move, so when the enemy unit's disembark ends within 8" of the Gretchin the opponent's enemy_ended_move window (SCARPER!) must open, as it does after a normal move. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive (P1 Custodes active, P2 Orks / Runt Swarm). Setup-only privilege (the Custodes list has no transport): the Custodes borrow the Ork Trukk with Custodian Guard Gamma embarked; Gretchin Alpha stands ~9" north of the Trukk. The Custodes confirm a tactical disembark (the CONFIRM_DISEMBARK action the disembark UI sends, positions from the engine's shape-aware placement): the StratagemDialog opens for PLAYER 2 with 'Custodian Guard Gamma has ended a move', an enabled SCARPER! 'Use on Gretchin Alpha', the window context names a disembark move, and the hot-seat overlay names Player 2. Declining closes it without opening a second window for the same move.

steps.comment: setup privilege: Runt Swarm for P2; the Custodes borrow the Ork Trukk with Custodian Guard Gamma embarked; Gretchin Alpha ~9" north of the Trukk
the Custodes confirm the disembark (CONFIRM_DISEMBARK, the action the disembark UI sends)

steps.equals: Custodian Guard Gamma has ended a move

steps.comment: one window per move — no second window for the same disembark
